narrative: Hubert Yee contributed to the TrueSight DAO's Build Game across strategy and marketing categories from June 2022 to September 2022. Primarily focused on strategy, he reviewed proposed strategies three times each to suggest specific improvements and highlight areas to watch out for, attended multiple FaceTime meetings, and provided reference materials. In marketing, he identified viable channel distribution partners three times and reached out to formalize arrangements with one. His most substantial work was developing a full-scale strategy and rollout action plan for DAO growth, including overview and system logic. Hubert also participated in MarketMonocle and MoonShot projects.
